name: agentgit
description: Coordination layer for coding agents: a shared ledger of in-flight work, versioned contracts, and a single verdict before every write. Reduces duplicate implementations, stale writes and clean-but-wrong merges when several agents share one workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Traffic lights for agents sharing one repository
interface.longDescription: Git merges text, not intentions. When two agents in one workspace change the same thing for the same reason, Git reports a conflict at best and a clean-but-wrong merge at worst. AgenticGit keeps a ledger of what is in flight, records the interfaces each task assumes, and answers one question before every write: allow, reuse, refresh, replan, wait or review. Changes are isolated in per-task worktrees with checkpoint commits; merges, rebases and discards are only ever described, never executed for you. Its panel draws one workspace's commit graph with every commit attributed to the Codex conversation that produced it, and explains any commit without leaving the conversation.
